what_happened: The decision-tree README under FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/ directly answers the dispatch's 'ceiling' question (finite presentations via IntPresentation.lean; bounded-quantifier witness-family certificates restricted to ZTime/Formula) without needing any new proof or build, letting point 4 of the research be fully grounded from an existing README rather than fresh exploration.

The PR #11 review (task 978, dispatch for the sibling PR-11 review) had not reported by the time this task needed its trial of the lemmas-only control; proceeded without it per the dispatch's conditional instruction and noted the gap explicitly in both deliverables rather than waiting.

Planning found the research-round reports have drifted since the records were rewritten in b63de1dd9: pr10-review.md cites 'Open decision 4 of records/milestones.md' three times (lines 97, 153, 246) for the evaluator-beside-the-lemmas question, which is now open decision 2 (decision 4 is the signature-layer timing question), and its line-155 claim about an open decision 2 that recorded 'who writes the record first?' no longer corresponds to anything in the record's list. Both reports also still describe PR #7 as open although it merged at 3c7197f84, and pr9-disposition.md's draft closing comment says ProofModeSoundness.lean carries forward unchanged while the decided position in pr9-comment.md is that its content becomes milestone D4's one soundness statement over TruthEnv. Phases 1, 2 and 4 of the plan are built around this reconciliation.

Running suite_selection_select once over the whole planned file set returned __FULL_SWEEP__ (sentinel only), which together with every path lying under specs/** and none being a report/plan/summary artifact put every prose phase squarely in plan-format.md's sub-case (a): the honest covering check is the diff read-through, with no suite claimable. This settled all three non-final phases' Tier Justification lines from one measured call rather than per-phase guessing.
